rca_of_issue:
Preview Environment Instability RCA:

Symptoms:
- Preview URL returns 502 Bad Gateway or 'not responding' message
- Works initially, then fails on subsequent requests
- Expo service shows frequent restarts in supervisor logs
- Metro bundler logs show ngrok tunnel errors: 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading body)'

Root Cause:
- Ngrok tunnel (used by Expo for external preview) is failing intermittently
- Metro bundler in CI mode with tunnel flag causes instability
- AsyncStorage version mismatch warning may contribute to instability

Mitigation:
- Wait 20-30 seconds between test runs for Metro to fully bundle
- Restart Expo service if 502 persists: sudo supervisorctl restart expo
- Consider removing --tunnel flag if only local testing needed
- Update @react-native-async-storage/async-storage to expected version 2.2.0

Workaround for Testing:
- Run tests in single session without page reloads when possible
- Use longer timeouts (10-15s) for initial page load
- Check curl https://split-local-first.preview.emergentagent.com before running Playwright tests
